title: Bounded Waits
prompt: Implement async def with_deadline(coro, seconds) awaiting asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=seconds) and returning ('ok', result) on success or ('timeout', None) on asyncio.TimeoutError. Provide sync wrapper run_deadline(coro, seconds).
boilerplate:
import asyncio

async def with_deadline(coro, seconds):
    pass

def run_deadline(coro, seconds):
    pass

tests.name: fast job succeeds
tests.code:
async def quick():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    return 'done'
assert run_deadline(quick(), 1) == ('ok', 'done')

tests.name: slow job times out
tests.code:
async def slow():
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    return 'late'
status, value = run_deadline(slow(), 0.05)
assert status == 'timeout' and value is None
tests.hint: TimeoutError becomes ('timeout', None) — never a hang.
